articles.author: Polymath Research Inc.
articles.headline: Polymath and High Ridge Trust Partner to Advance Institutional Infrastructure for Tokenized Securities
sourceWarnings: La noticia corresponde al objetivo de adquisición Polymath; la compra por TruGolf seguía sujeta a condiciones.
articles.summary: Polymath, which TruGolf had agreed to acquire subject to closing conditions, announced a tokenized-securities infrastructure partnership with High Ridge Trust. The announcement does not establish completion of TruGolf's acquisition.
